conceptZh: 兩隊積木小兵從左右拉扯，一邊拉著「犭」，一邊拉著「師」，拉到彈簧啪地合在一起，積木拼出一隻小獅子在旁邊搖鬃毛。
object: a squad of interlocking toy building bricks in orange, yellow and brown that march, pull a rope and stack themselves into a tiny maned lion
morph: two brick teams tug the left part 犭 and right part 師 of 獅 apart, then a spring pulls them together into one glyph
creativeAngle: 拔河：積木小隊分兩隊拉扯左邊「犭」與右邊「師」，繩子一斷彈簧把兩邊拉合，旁邊積木堆成小獅子甩鬃毛。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and playful, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-sky-blue backdrop with a pale cream floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated burnt-orange Traditional Chinese glyph 獅, the left part 犭 beside the right part 師, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is a squad of original interlocking toy building bricks (small yellow, red and brown bricks with simple dot faces and tiny stubby legs) that march, stack themselves and topple; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): two squads of bricks march in from the left and right edges, each squad hauling one end of a thick red rope tied to a floating orange stroke group; the left group is the 犭 and the right group is the 師, and the first spoken 獅 lands as the two squads plant their feet and start to pull. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the tug-of-war grows wild, the brick squads lean back at an angle, the rope stretches like gum and a small brick at the back is yanked into the air and bounces back down, dizzy; the second spoken 獅 lands as the rope snaps. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the two halves spring inward on a big coil spring, slam together with a bright click and settle as one perfect 獅, while the brick squads tumble backward into a heap of tiny bricks and then pop up again; at the same moment the word 獅子 is spoken as the loose bricks off to the side stack up into a small lion with a fluffy brick-mane that shakes its head. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 獅 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in orange; the brick lion on the floor to the side lifts one stubby paw and sways its mane in a happy wiggle while the squad waves little arms, nobody touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「獅、獅、獅子」, read as ㄕ、ㄕ、ㄕ ㄗ˙, first utterance at about 0.7s, second at about 2.9s, the word at about 4.5s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft brick clicks and a rope twang under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 巨大的玩具消防車對著「躲」得超明顯的布忍者耍威風衝過來，布忍者側身一閃、小指頭一戳，消防車像大樹一樣轟然倒下，車頂的橘色水管桿子被震落排成「獅」，遲到的煙霧彈這時才噗地炸開，在布忍者頭上圍成一圈圓鬃毛，變成一隻小獅子。
object: a tiny grey felt ninja with button eyes and a stubby smoke bomb, versus a huge chunky red toy fire engine whose roof rack carries orange ladder bars
morph: the fire engine charges, the ninja gives one poke, the engine topples like a tree and the THUMP shakes the orange ladder bars off its roof so they land as 犭 on the left and 師 on the right, forming 獅; a late smoke-bomb puff ringing the ninja's head like a mane turns him into a little lion as 獅子 is spoken
creativeAngle: 改用「大對小」的實體笑料：前兩版是絨毛小獅子甩鬃毛、積木拔河，這版讓笨重的消防車對布忍者耍威風衝鋒，布忍者只戳一下就讓它整台倒下，倒地的震動把車頂的水管桿子震成「獅」字。詞語「獅子」不另加道具，而是用布忍者的招牌失誤——慢半拍的煙霧彈——噗地在他頭上炸成一圈圓鬃毛，他自己就變成小獅子，聲音與畫面同一個故事。
promptEn:
An exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright soft lighting, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-mint backdrop and a pale cream floor, nothing else behind. The only on-screen text is one bold saturated burnt-orange Traditional Chinese glyph 獅 (left part 犭, right part 師), which forms at center, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. Cast: a tiny grey felt ninja with black button eyes, a stitched headband and a fat little smoke bomb, who is sure he is invisible; and a huge chunky red toy fire engine with a goofy headlight face, a roof rack stacked with orange ladder bars, and a white hose that has a mind of its own. No real people.

0.0-1.5s: The felt ninja crouches dead center behind a single tiny green leaf, completely visible, one button eye peeking proudly. From the left edge the giant fire engine rolls in, bounces on its tires like flexing muscles and blares its headlights at him. The hose rears up like a cobra, then sprays the engine's own windshield. The first spoken 獅 lands as the ninja's eyes dart left and he hugs his leaf tighter.

1.5-3.2s: The engine revs, squashes low, and charges right across the frame straight at the ninja. The ninja throws his smoke bomb: it bounces, rolls, fizzles, and does nothing. He stares at it, shrugs.

3.2-4.8s: A frozen half-beat as the engine looms over him. The ninja simply hops one tiny step to the side and pokes the front bumper with one stubby finger. The engine tips sideways like a falling tree, slow then fast, and lands on its back at the lower right with a cartoon THUMP, tires spinning. The shake sends the orange ladder bars jumping off the roof rack; they rattle in mid-air and drop into place as 犭 on the left and 師 on the right, snapping into one perfect centered 獅. The second spoken 獅 lands exactly as the last bar clicks in.

4.8-8.0s: The glyph 獅 stays perfectly still, crisp and unobstructed. The ninja climbs onto the toppled engine's belly in the lower right, well clear of the strokes, and strikes a victory pose. The forgotten smoke bomb finally pops with a soft POOF, and the round grey puff rings his head like a fluffy lion's mane. He blinks, then throws both paws up in a tiny silent roar. The word 獅子 is spoken exactly at that roar. He wobbles happily on the spinning tire while the hose drips one last drop on the engine's face.

Narration, off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct with clear tones, no erhua, no other dialogue: the voice says exactly 「獅、獅、獅子」, read as ㄕ、ㄕ、ㄕ ㄗ˙. First 獅 at about 0.8s, second 獅 at about 4.4s, 獅子 at about 5.6s, then silence with no repeats. Only soft toy squeaks, a rubbery THUMP and a gentle poof under the voice, no music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
